merchant/31434.htm.text: Blueprint Seller Shaling: Welcome! I'm Shaling. I used to sell blueprints, but my real dream is to become an adventurer someday! First, I'll explore Cruma Tower! What? You're an adventurer? Oh! I used to sell blueprints, but since those technologies became public there's no need for them anymore. O…

Q00027_ChestCaughtWithABaitOfWind/31434-.text: Blueprint Seller Shaling: Hello! what ca I do for you? Do you need the blueprint for an extraordinary golem? Sorry, but I have only ordinary ones left now. Recently, I completed a really great golem bluprint, but I accidently dropped it off of the bridge and lost it! What a terrible loss!
Blueprint Seller Shaling: This is amazing! How did you find it? You must be a great adventurer! Thank you so much! Please accept this token of my appreciation!
Blueprint Seller Shaling: You said you'd found the blueprint, but you have neither the blueprint nor the box! Are you teasing me?
